feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 26 August 2026 10:16pm
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

E or NE 3 or 4, occasionally 5, backing N or NE 2 or 3 in the afternoon, then backing NW 4 occasionally 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then outbreaks of rain developing in the afternoon, heavy in places later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

N or NW 3 to 5, backing W or NW, becoming variable or SW 3 or less overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight becoming smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain at first, soon becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Saturday, 29 August 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

Variable or SW 3 or less, soon settling E or SE 3 to 5, becoming cyclonic for a time, then becoming N or NW later. Backing W or SW overnight.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then a spell of rain soon arriving clearing to become fair later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Sunday, 30 August 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

W or SW 2 to 4, soon backing S or SE, veering NW overnight.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather)##

Showers later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 19°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Monday, 31 August 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

NW 3 or 4 soon backing WNW or W 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the north.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight at first, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Showers, becoming mostly fair.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good.

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
